title: Iron Legion morale rules (content/rules/morale.json5)
description: Engine tunables read by the morale, routing, rally and shatter systems (Simulation Spec 7 and 15.1). One merged object per enabled mod set; every field is required because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

t_unsettled.description: Morale at or below which a regiment is Unsettled (SIM-MOR-003).

t_shaken.description: Morale at or below which a regiment is Shaken (SIM-MOR-003).

t_broken.description: Morale at or below which a regiment is Broken (SIM-MOR-003).

t_routing.description: Morale at or below which a regiment routs (SIM-MOR-003).

hysteresis.description: Points above a threshold needed to leave a state upward (SIM-MOR-003).

rally_margin.description: Points above t_routing needed to rally (SIM-MOR-031).

rally_safe_radius.description: Metres free of enemies needed to rally (SIM-MOR-031).

max_routs.description: Routs after which the next one shatters the regiment (SIM-MOR-032).

shatter_strength.description: Fraction of initial strength below which a rout shatters (SIM-MOR-032).

general_death_shock.description: One-time morale loss when the general dies (SIM-MOR-014).

rout_shock.description: One-time morale loss to allies of a routing regiment (SIM-MOR-033).

rout_shock_radius.description: Metres within which the rout shock applies (SIM-MOR-033).

disengage_penalty.description: One-time morale loss when ordered away from a fight (SIM-MOR-025).

charged_penalty.description: One-time morale loss when charged from flank or rear; half from the front (SIM-MOR-026).

casualty_rate_ref.description: Fraction lost in 5 s that is a full casualty_rate drain (SIM-MOR-010).

casualty_total_ref.description: Fraction lost overall that is a full casualty_total drain (SIM-MOR-011).

fatigue_start.description: Mean fatigue at which the fatigue factor starts (SIM-MOR-012).

ally_radius.description: Metres for counting nearby allies (SIM-MOR-015, SIM-MOR-016).

allies_ref.description: Steady allies nearby that saturate allies_near (SIM-MOR-015).

routing_ref.description: Routing allies nearby that saturate allies_routing (SIM-MOR-016).

outnumber_ref.description: Enemy-to-own ratio excess that saturates outnumbered (SIM-MOR-020).

safe_radius.description: Metres free of enemies for the recovery factor (SIM-MOR-024).

exp_bonus.description: Starting morale bonus per experience level (SIM-MOR-001).

w.description: Factor weights in points per second at full effect (SIM-MOR-002).

state_mults.description: Attack, defence, attack-interval and speed multipliers per morale state; Shattered uses the routing row (SIM-MOR-004).
